title: A Compose default or alternative value that is itself a credential literal
summary: Compose default and alternative value forms hold text of their own: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${GITHUB_TOKEN:-<literal>} supplies the literal whenever the variable is unset or empty. Paired with the same line whose default is empty (${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}) and the required form (${GITHUB_TOKEN:?message}), which hold no credential bytes.
rationale: Reference syntax is not the same as a reference. In ${VAR:-default} the part after :- is the value Compose uses when VAR is unset or empty, so a credential written there is committed to the file and used as the value; the surrounding ${...:-...} marks only where the value goes. The span to cover is the default text alone, not the delimiters. The twins keep the shape and the key name and change only what follows :- (nothing) or :? (an error message, which is not the variable's value), so the outcome flips on the default text. This is the Compose-specific resolution rule; it is not claimed for other shells or tools. Not claimed: ${VAR-default} (default only when unset) and ${VAR:+replacement} follow the same documented substitution rule but have no fixture here.

expectation.rationale: Flagged, covering the default text only. Docker documents ${VAR:-default} as the value of VAR if set and non-empty, otherwise default, so the default is the value Compose uses in that case. GitHub documents the ghp_ prefix for a classic personal access token. The empty default and the required form are not flagged: the first has no value bytes and the second names an error message, not a value. The fixture value is synthetic and was built from an authored description, not issued.

sources.supports: Default value: ${VAR:-default} -> value of VAR if set and non-empty, otherwise default; ${VAR-default} -> value of VAR if set, otherwise default. Required value: ${VAR:?error} -> value of VAR if set and non-empty, otherwise exit with error.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Authored from the cited pages read on 2026-10-04, before any scanner was consulted. Origin: evidence-derived and synthetic. The Docker pages do not say a default is meant for secrets; that a ghp_ default is a credential comes from the GitHub token format, not from Compose.

relations.note: The empty-default and required-message twins project that existing Case; this Case is the side whose default text is the credential.
